visualCharacteristics.purpose: Hosted video player with poster image and play button
visualCharacteristics.layout: 16:9 poster with a centred play button; the player replaces the poster on click; optional caption below
notable: mp4 / webm play in an HTML5 video, YouTube / Vimeo in a privacy-friendly iframe
autoplay-background: muted looping background video with overlay graphic and a pause toggle; respects prefers-reduced-motion

contentPattern.structure: One row: video link (file, YouTube or Vimeo), optional poster picture, optional caption paragraphs; autoplay-background: a second picture is the overlay graphic

usage: Use to embed one video with a poster image, or a decorative background video.
reuseGuidance: Fits a single video; embed covers generic third-party embeds, text-media (wide-media) a video beside text.
